name: Residente
bio: Residente (born René Pérez Joglar) is a Puerto Rican rapper, singer, songwriter and filmmaker. He is best known as one of the members of alternative rap band Calle 13. Along with his siblings, Eduardo (Visitante) and Ileana Cabra, they released five albums winning four Grammy Awards and 27 Latin Grammy Awards. Aside from music, Residente has also delved into producing documentaries including Sin Mapa (2009) and Residente (2017) and has directed some of his own music videos.

credits.title: Frank & Louis
credits.overview: Frank, serving a life sentence, takes a prison job caring for aging incarcerated men with Alzheimer’s and dementia. What begins as a self-interested bid for parole becomes a profound, transformative bond with fellow prisoner Louis, offering Frank a glimpse of redemption in an unforgiving place.

credits.overview: PsiQuis: Un Giro Decolonial is a documentary that presents and discusses the psychological impact that colonialism has had on the Puerto Rican people. The director analyzes the traumas generated in Puerto Rican society by that colonial experience.
